title: Top 3 Heat Pump ISSUES in Winter!
summary: HVAC technician lists the three most common winter heat pump problems: low refrigerant hidden by backup heat, poor maintenance, and defrost failures.

verdicts.note: Dirty coils and filters and wrong charge measurably reduce heat pump efficiency in field studies.

Filters ran from clean to moderately dirty; one extreme filter cut fan airflow by 69%, but in testing even a very dirty filter shifted the airflow curve less than 10% versus clean, a small effect for typical neglect.
